approval_domains.semantics: Reusable only within exact scope and validity until revoked/superseded; grant evidence is not effect proof.
Domain-specific single-use consumption evidence; separate from fulfillment/effect proof.
Exact principal/effect/subject/configuration binding and sequence lifetime; verifier is reusable and has no consumption ledger.
The same exact valid AdmissionEvidence can be verified for multiple transport attempts; ambiguous design decision, not proven one-shot.
Canonical retention binds exact session/turn/request/operation/text; operation-derived identity supplies idempotency, not a generic FIDES approval.
Domain-specific leases, predecessor/generation and adoption bindings; revocation/supersession semantics are not reducible to session approval.

crash_windows.risk: unused durable authority may remain valid until expiry/revocation
one-shot authority may be lost without a durable recoverable intent
effect may have occurred without a local result record
response known in process but absent after crash
hash-linked custody supports reconstruction, subject to atomic writer guarantees

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No generic cross-domain content-integrity class or generic content-to-sink rule.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Untrusted content cannot drive a sink that rejects it.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS intentionally retains several axes instead of one trusted/untrusted bit.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: State a no-self-promotion law without flattening the existing axes.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: Cross-subsystem derived artifacts do not uniformly preserve a confidentiality restriction.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Public, private, and identity-scoped confidentiality constrain destinations.
crosswalk.important_differences: Protections are domain-local; no common confidentiality order propagates through every derivation and destination.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Study a small restriction-carrying envelope only at concrete cross-domain handoffs.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No general datum-recipient principal set, union-on-derivation rule, or destination subset check was found.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Identity content carries principal sets; combinations union them; destinations authorize every principal.
crosswalk.important_differences: Existing principals chiefly answer who may perform an effect, not who may receive derived data.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Keep disclosure authority separate from effect authority; investigate only where an actual export consumer needs it.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: The invariant is piecemeal and weaker in legacy memory/perception context paths.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Remote claims may restrict but cannot self-promote trust, reduce confidentiality, or invent principal authority.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS enforces non-promotion at hardened authority boundaries but lacks one content-label merge operator.
sentientos_analogues: model output cannot become authority evidence
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Document external material may constrain itself but needs independent local evidence to gain status.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No uniform tier-resolution algorithm spans tool/provider/perception outputs.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Per-item labels, source declarations, hidden-reference labels, and secure defaults have ordered authority.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS has exact domain schemas rather than a generic label precedence tier.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Prefer explicit local fallback ownership and reject argument-shaped policy claims.

crosswalk.fides_security_property: Transformations inherit or restrict source labels, commonly using most-restrictive propagation.
crosswalk.important_differences: Strong newer custody chains preserve exact inputs; legacy summaries can lose event identity and do not propagate privacy uniformly.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Unify laws about authority, provenance loss, currentness, and confidentiality while leaving domains typed.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: There is no single default for arbitrary unlabeled content.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Unknown output defaults to untrusted integrity.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS distinguishes unknown, untrusted, false, stale, and authority-ineligible.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Default conservatively per consequence: unknown epistemically, ineligible for authority, and privacy-conservative where disclosure is possible.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: Data-disclosure constraints are less uniform than effect admission.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Sensitive tools declare integrity, confidentiality, and principal constraints enforced before execution.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS gates exact capability/effect/subject/configuration and operational state, but not a generic content confidentiality label.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Continue exact domain admission; add no middleware merely for architectural resemblance.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No general adversarial-content reference facility for cognition.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Untrusted raw bytes may remain outside primary model context behind a reference.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS indirection protects credentials/effect material from general cognition; it is not a generic untrusted-content variable store.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Opaque, owner-resolved handles are valuable where a named consumer can operate without model visibility.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: FIDES-style cognitive quarantine is genuinely absent.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: A separate tool-free model inspects hidden content; outputs retain restrictions and cannot declassify.
crosswalk.important_differences: Existing quarantine controls admission/integrity or exposure selection; none is an isolated tool-free cognition worker whose output retains source restrictions.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Promising only for identified adversarial web/provider/perception paths; it is not universally necessary.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No general hidden-content forwarding path across arbitrary cognition tools.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Hidden references cross permitted paths without revealing raw bytes to primary cognition.
crosswalk.important_differences: Effect custody can be stronger and more exact than FIDES generic hidden variables, but generic cognitive forwarding is absent.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Preserve raw-byte separation where deterministic owners can resolve exact handles.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No gap on hardened traced paths; legacy approval-like records vary.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Approval binds the exact resolved invocation in its owning session; edits require new approval.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS binding uses explicit domain identities and sequence validity rather than a single session invocation occurrence.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Keep exact resolved-content/configuration binding as a reusable invariant.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: External-model AdmissionEvidence can authorize repeated attempts for the same exact request/configuration within sequence lifetime; intent is ambiguous.
crosswalk.important_differences: Fulfillment consumption is single-use in its domain; RuntimeAdmissionVerifier has no consumption ledger and permits repeat verification while valid.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Decide reuse versus one-shot per effect and specify durable attempt/receipt recovery before changing semantics.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No missing universal session abstraction is established.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Labels, variables, audits, and approvals belong to an owning session.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS scopes different security facts to precise domain identities rather than one universal session.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Do not collapse generation, principal, admission, conversation, and invocation identity.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: No distinct FIDES audit invariant is missing beyond consistent denial/attempt coverage.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Blocked and approval-gated operations produce explicit audit state.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS audit integrity can itself constrain authority and has specialized durable receipts; coverage remains surface-specific.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Retain stage-specific receipts and make gaps explicit rather than adopting a simpler log.

crosswalk.current_sentientos_gap: Response/material-level restrictions do not consistently survive derivation.
crosswalk.fides_security_property: Whole-context taint is safe but can reduce utility; finer scoping/decay remains open.
crosswalk.important_differences: SentientOS already uses domain-specific item granularity; it has no whole-context generic taint to decay.
crosswalk.transferable_lesson: Use the smallest current consumer-owned unit: fact, event, memory fragment, response material, or claim/evidence—not arbitrary JSONPath.

derivation_laws.finding: All traced authority gates demand independent typed admission; legacy text can influence candidates but not satisfy a gate.
Digest-bound custody preserves sources; legacy perception aggregation and memory summaries can lose exact source identity.
World-State and host gates retain types; legacy narrative context is not uniformly labeled interpretation.
Privacy and secrecy controls exist, but no cross-domain propagation contract was found.
Freshness is explicit in newer gates; legacy timestamp coercion and relevance ranking are weaker.
derivation_laws.law: staleness cannot improve without new evidence

derivation_laws.finding: External-model material is explicitly non-authoritative; no universal law covers every legacy ingress.
Newer artifacts disclose sources, while legacy summaries need not enumerate source digests.
derivation_laws.law: lossy derivation must disclose provenance loss

fides_snapshot.network_research: Microsoft Agent Framework public repository cloned successfully; Microsoft Research publication page retrieved; web search and guessed Microsoft Learn URL were unavailable, so no separate Learn page claim is made.
not_independently_verified: A distinct current Microsoft Learn page titled Agent Security with FIDES was not located through the available endpoint; equivalent current Microsoft repository documentation was verified.

findings.blind_forwarding: Already strong for credentials and exact effect material, narrower for generic cognition.
findings.external_model_admission: One admission can authorize repeated exact attempts while valid; repository evidence does not establish whether this is intentional.
findings.principal_confidentiality: Effect principals are explicit and strong; general data-recipient principal sets and derivation union are absent.
findings.quarantine: FIDES-style cognitive quarantine is genuinely absent; runtime quarantine and transient material custody are only partial analogues.
findings.restriction_only: A strong non-promotion intent exists on hardened surfaces, but only piecemeal rather than as a repository-wide law.
findings.runtime_admission: Not one-shot by implementation; validity-window verification is repeatable.
findings.unknown: Unknown, untrusted, false, provenance-incomplete, authority-ineligible, and privacy-conservative remain distinct.

non_conclusions: Trusted/untrusted is not imposed on all data.
Runtime admissions are not assumed one-shot.
Raw external material is not always required to be hidden.
Data confidentiality is not effect authority.
FIDES middleware is not proposed for SentientOS.
required_sections: What SentientOS should explicitly NOT copy
